programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: Dr Michelle and Dr Emma are on high alert for a mother-to-be who is paralysed and unresponsive from a suspected stroke. Dr Bjorn and Dr Martin’s critically injured patient clings to life after a camper trailer rolled over him.

programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: Nurse Elle and Dr Steve suspect a cyclist with a badly broken leg is being far too brave and could be masking other injuries. Dr Michelle puts lunch on hold as she and Dr Jonathan examine a 67-year-old motorbike rider for broken bones.

programs.title: Paramedics
programs.desc: Emergency responders face real-life crises, including accidents, medical emergencies, and rescue operations. The show follows paramedics, police, and firefighters as they handle high-pressure situations. Through real footage and firsthand accounts, it reveals the intensity and urgency of emergency services.
